title: GPT-3: THE GEOMETRY OF IN-CONTEXT LEARNING

beats.text: Every time an AI learned a new task. Engineers had to retrain millions of weights.
beats.visual_focus: A massive neural net freezing in place while heavy mechanical wrenches forcefully twist its internal nodes.

visual_blueprint.title: THE FINE-TUNING WALL
visual_blueprint.sub: Every single task required full weight retraining

motif_params.title: THE FINE-TUNING WALL
motif_params.sub: Every single task required full weight retraining

beats.text: Fine-tuning was exhausting. You needed thousands of curated examples. Adding one simple task meant burning days of compute retraining frozen network weights.
beats.visual_focus: Piles of labeled datasets feeding an overheating server rack that stalls out trying to adapt to a simple translation task.

visual_blueprint.title: DATA HUNGRY BOTTLENECK
visual_blueprint.sub: Thousands of labeled examples required per task

motif_params.title: DATA HUNGRY BOTTLENECK
motif_params.sub: Thousands of labeled examples required per task

beats.text: Enter GPT-3 with one hundred seventy-five billion parameters. It performs new tasks instantly inside the prompt window without updating a single weight.
beats.visual_focus: A giant 175-billion parameter network remaining completely frozen while a prompt stream acts like a prism, bending incoming signals.

beats.text: Attention heads scan your few-shot demonstration tokens. They steer internal activation trajectories in real time. Simulating gradient descent directly within forward passes.
beats.visual_focus: Vector flow lines shifting dynamically inside latent space as demonstration tokens redirect the activation stream without weight updates.

beats.text: Without updating a single parameter. Few-shot accuracy leaped to ninety-two point five percent. Outperforming heavily fine-tuned baselines by twenty-seven percent.
beats.visual_focus: A glowing green bar chart shooting past standard fine-tuned models on benchmarks spanning translation, cloze tasks, and arithmetic.
